title: PAR-03 standalone DXF group-code 80-89 type boundary
mode: Focused local classifier and regression fast slice

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. This slice adds a focused common-metadata test setup correction, plan progress, and this receipt; no files were staged or committed.

implementation.change: Classify standalone DXF group codes 80-89 as Unknown, preserving ASCII values while refusing to guess binary width; retain the historical string interpretation only in the explicit LibreCadMasterLegacy profile. Keep code 1009 in the string range and start the typed double range at 1010.
assertions: Classifier boundaries 79/80/89/90 match the documented assignment boundary.
Standalone ASCII preserves 80-89 values without assigning a type.
Standalone binary reading and typed writing fail closed for 80-89.
The explicit legacy profile still round-trips 80-89 as strings.
Common-object metadata test uses a valid generated SPATIAL_FILTER with two boundary points and complete 12-value matrices, preserving the PAR-139 writer's incomplete-input refusal.
implementation.claimBoundary: This resolves only the classifier's 80-89 standalone/legacy boundary and the code-1009 string boundary. It does not complete the PAR-03 code/context audit or establish broad DXF interoperability or format support.

nextAction: Continue the source- and context-backed PAR-03 audit for unresolved DXF code spans; do not assign binary widths from neighboring ranges or wait on external qualification.
